Title: OrderRequest — stock that fell below the ordered quantity after the return: the answer is not a 500 with no text (inventory is NOT checked when the order is created from the requisition)
Preconditions: Dedicated punchout buyer (the PUNCHOUT_MAPPING_REQUISITION buyer, a user mapping); Punchout.Enabled on for the configuration-0 store; configuration 0 (no default method codes). A fresh session for this case only: the requisition items are ordered by one purchase order at most, and the PO number and payload id are terminal.
